name: UnitedHealthcare Medicare (AARP Medicare Advantage)
why: Largest Medicare Advantage carrier (~13.1M approx members in catalog); national brand.

name: Humana Medicare
why: Second-largest Medicare carrier (~11.1M); national brand with MyHumana account and guest Pay Now.

name: Wellcare (Centene) Medicare
why: ~9.9M; major national MA/PDP brand. The separate Wellcare PDP premium-billing record bills through the same Wellcare site, so it is not picked.

name: Aetna Medicare
why: ~8.0M; national MA/SilverScript brand. The separate SilverScript PDP record is the same company/site.

name: HealthSpring (formerly Cigna Medicare)
why: ~3.3M; national MA/PDP brand with a distinct premium payment portal.

name: Kaiser Permanente Senior Advantage
why: ~2.1M; largest regional MA plan, kp.org premium billing.

name: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield Medicare
why: ~2.0M; largest Blue plan family for Medicare, Quick Pay + account autopay.

name: Mutual of Omaha Medicare Supplement
why: One of the largest Medigap carriers; distinct Customer Access billing site (premium-billing record chosen over the duplicate 5df5db).

name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan Medicare (Medicare Plus Blue, BCN Advantage)
why: ~700K; largest Blue Medicare book outside Anthem with its own bcbsm.com premium billing. Replaces AARP Medicare Supplement, which bills through the same uhc.com site as the UnitedHealthcare Medicare pick.

name: Medicare Premium Bill (CMS-500, Medicare.gov / Medicare Easy Pay)
why: The federal Medicare premium bill sent to everyone who pays Part A, Part B or Part D IRMAA directly instead of through Social Security; a core Medicare bill with its own payment flow (Medicare account + Pay.gov, Easy Pay). Replaces SCAN Health Plan (~461K, regional) as the 10th pick in review; the SCAN dossier stays valid. The duplicate record original-medicare-part-a-part-b-premiums-cms-med-b69d6d is the same bill.

name: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Medicare
why: ~445K; largest Blue Medicare plan in PA/DE/WV/NY with its own eBill premium portal (Pay Premium, Auto Pay, Go Paperless).

name: Healthfirst Medicare Advantage
why: ~373K; largest NYC-area nonprofit MA plan; online, first-payment, phone and mail premium payment.

name: Priority Health Medicare
why: ~287K; largest Michigan MA plan after BCBSM; EFT, guest pay, Pay My Premium.

name: Excellus BlueCross BlueShield Medicare
why: ~264K; upstate NY Blue plan with Express Pay and automatic withdrawals on the 4th.

name: Blue Cross NC Medicare
why: ~243K; North Carolina Blue plan with guest pay and bank-only autopay.

name: Florida Blue Medicare
why: ~202K (MA alone; large Medigap book); guest payment, autopay, retail cash payments.

name: Blue Shield of California Medicare
why: ~168K; California Blue plan with Pay my premium (no account), AutoPay and no fees.

name: UPMC for Life (UPMC Health Plan)
why: ~230K; western PA MA plan with member-site/app premium payments and autopay.

name: Independence Blue Cross Medicare
why: ~156K; Philadelphia-area Blue plan with eBill, recurring payments and Pay by Text.

name: EmblemHealth Medicare
why: ~143K (MA + PDP); NYC plan with Pay as Guest and myEmblemHealth autopay. Taken instead of Horizon BCBSNJ, whose public payment pages block automated reading.
